thread:
maria: Heads-up: the API ref page for /v1/generate currently shows a 200 sample with a full "result" object. In production we sometimes return 202 for queued requests and `result` is null. This is causing confusion and some SDK snippets assume immediate results.

sam: Which doc exactly? I just had a support ticket about it.

maria: docs/reference/generate.md 12. The example includes "status": "queued" *and* a non-null "result" in the same sample which is misleading.

jess: Oof. That could break example-driven tests too. Ruby snippets flaked in CI earlier.

sam: We should show both flows: a 202 queued response (with result=null) and a 200 sync response (with result). Or mark `result` as nullable in the schema and update snippets accordingly.

maria: My draft fix: update openapi to mark `result` nullable, replace the sample with a 202 queued payload, and add an explicit sync example using ?wait_for_completion=true. Also add a short migration note for folks parsing body.result directly. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/802

nnamdi: +1 on the migration note. Recommend a one-liner for the changelog and a KB for support.

jess: I'll patch the JS/Python snippets to check status before using result. Tiny pattern to include:

if (resp.status === 202) {
  // poll or handle queued response
} else {
  use(resp.result)
}

sam: I'll add a 202 example in openapi.yaml and make `result` nullable on 200 responses. Will also regenerate the static examples.

maria: Can we land this by EOD? Support is getting multiple asks.

support: We're drafting a KB entry that references the new examples and the recommended client pattern.

nnamdi: After merge, ping SDK leads so clients can ship a tiny compatibility patch.

jess: Small nit: I found inconsistent param names across pages (`max_new_tokens` vs `max_tokens`). Can we not mix that into this PR? Better as a follow-up.

maria: Agreed 12 created https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/issues/421 for param-name harmonization and linked it in PR.

sam: Also please add a unit test for the example flow so example-driven tests don't regress. I'll update client tests to accept nullable result.

deploy-bot: Deploy preview: https://deploy-preview-802--docs.redwood.ai 12 build succeeded :white_check_mark:

maria: Thanks all 12 I'll merge once approvals are in and then coordinate with platform to sync OpenAPI in the infra repo.

jess: Reviewing now. I'll push small fixes to the Python snippet (prefer status-check vs catching exceptions).

support: Once merged we'll publish the KB draft and notify customers who reported this.

nnamdi: Nice quick turnaround. Please add the one-line changelog entry: "Clarified /v1/generate examples: queued (202) vs immediate (200)."

maria: Done. Merging after a final codeowner approval. Thanks!
